expectation: Membrane/fibre stain on nerves and Schwann/enteric glia. In gut wall that means myenteric plexus ganglia between muscle layers, submucosal plexus and fine mucosal fibres, plus a few pericytes and FDCs in follicles. Sparse, discrete fibres and clusters on a dark background.
observed: A: the whole muscularis propria glows evenly yellow, as do vessel rings and the muscularis mucosae (all smooth muscle). No discrete plexus. B, C: dim haze, epithelium dark. D: blurred haze with no cells. E: CD21 is saturated haze, so it tells nothing.
why: The signal follows smooth-muscle compartments as broad haze, with no discrete nerve or glial fibres or cells at any scale, and D shows no cellular outline.
notes: NGFR lights the whole smooth-muscle wall, vessel walls and muscularis mucosae evenly, a pattern typical of cross-reactivity or autofluorescence. There are no plexus or nerve fibres, the brightest-cell close-up is haze, and the CD21 partner has no structure.
